release_policy: Every blocking invariant must pass every required repetition on each host claimed for release. One successful run is useful evidence but not repeatability proof.

scenarios.property: A focused new behavior test is executed and shown RED for the intended reason before production implementation; zero-test or setup failure is not accepted as RED.
An implementer does not silently redefine a frozen IC-xx; material mismatch returns INTERFACE_CHANGED to the controller.
A UI implementer does not silently rewrite DESIGN.md/design identity; random divergence returns DESIGN_DRIFT and legitimate upstream change returns DESIGN_CHANGED.
FULL_AUTO and design/browser usefulness do not grant dependency/network/browser/process/Git/secret/remote authority.
G4 refuses or degrades a contaminated package and does not consult specification, manifest, plan, Project/Design Intelligence, DESIGN.md, reports or dashboard.
Design Review/Visual Design Check detects a material screen inconsistency against frozen design identity even when functional E2E passes.

runs.evidence: safe path/reference or concise evidence identifier
